hero.intro: Platinum-cured silicone hoses are used where the hose must not taint or contaminate the product: pharmaceutical, cosmetic, fine chemical and food processing. Braid or wire reinforcement adds pressure and vacuum resistance, and a PFA lining extends chemical resistance.

items.a: Platinum curing leaves no peroxide by-products in the rubber, so the hose has very low extractables, which is why it is used in pharmaceutical and high-purity food transfer.

items.q: What is a PFA-lined silicone hose for?
items.a: The PFA liner gives the chemical resistance of a fluoropolymer while the silicone body keeps the hose flexible, so it suits solvents and aggressive products that would attack plain silicone.

products.title: Flat NBR-Coated Textile Delivery Hose for Water and Oils, 1 1/4"–10"
products.descriptionShort: NBR lay-flat delivery hose with a circular-woven yarn jacket and nitrile/PVC coating for water and oil pumping, 1 1/4" to 10", 10 to 28 bar, -30 °C to +80 °C, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
This NBR lay-flat delivery hose is a durable pumping hose with a circular-woven synthetic yarn jacket. A nitrile rubber and PVC compound is extruded directly onto the fabric without adhesives, giving a homogeneous wall. It covers 30 mm to 254 mm (1 1/4" to 10") for water and oils.

Construction

  • Jacket: circular-woven high-tenacity synthetic yarn
  • Coating: nitrile rubber and PVC, extruded onto the fabric without adhesives
  • Lining tensile strength at least 10.5 MPa; over 400% elongation and over 2,000 abrasion cycles, as stated by the maker
  • Working pressure 10 to 28 bar by size
  • Temperature range -30 °C to +80 °C

Applications

  • Water transfer
  • Irrigation
  • Mining and construction
  • Sewage and drainage
  • Electrical cable protection

The listed range is -30 °C to +80 °C. The maker calls the lining excellent against seawater, oils, greases and hydrocarbons. Check the fluid and temperature together before ordering. The NBR lay-flat hose collapses flat for storage and is a delivery hose with working pressure up to 28 bar. The PVC suction hoses have a spiral that holds the bore open for vacuum and suction. Choose by delivery against suction duty.

Sizes and ratings

A size table follows with 19 part numbers from 1 1/4" (30 mm) to 10" (254 mm). Working pressure runs from 28 bar on the smallest sizes to 10 bar on the largest, with burst pressure from 85 to 24 bar. Weight runs from 0.26 to 3.9 kg per metre. Standard lengths are 15, 20, 30, 60 and 100 m, up to 200 m on request.

Ordering

Hose-end couplings in cam and groove, Bauer, Perrot, Victaulic and Storz styles are offered. To quote, send the size, length, coupling style, working pressure and quantity. Supplied from Dubai, UAE; availability and lead time are confirmed at quotation.

products.title: Stainless Steel Corrugated Hose, Unbraided and Braided, 1/4"–12" — ISO 10380
products.descriptionShort: Stainless steel corrugated hose in AISI 316 with one or two AISI 304 braids or none, 1/4" to 12" (DN 6 to DN 300), -200 °C to +800 °C, built to ISO 10380, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
This stainless steel corrugated hose is built from an annular, parallel-wave corrugated tube in AISI 316 (1.4404) with one or two outer braids in AISI 304, or none. The corrugated tube keeps the hose tight against chemical attack from inside, and the braid takes the pressure and protects against abrasion. It runs from 1/4" to 12".

Construction

  • Tube: annular corrugated AISI 316 (1.4404), made to ISO 10380
  • Braid: AISI 304, one or two braids; unbraided versions in every size
  • Continuous temperature -200 °C to +800 °C
  • End fittings TIG welded in AISI 316 under argon shielding, standard or to customer drawing
  • Coil lengths 10, 25 or 50 m depending on size

Applications

  • Steam and hot water
  • Liquefied gases and refrigeration
  • Chemical process lines
  • High-temperature gases
  • Pump and vibration connections

The source quotes a continuous range of -200 °C to +800 °C, which covers liquefied gases, steam and hot gases. Give us the service temperature and medium when you enquire so the right braid count and fittings are quoted. The corrugated metal hose is rated -200 °C to +800 °C and up to 275 bar in the size tables, with an AISI 316 tube. The PTFE hoses in our range are rated to +260 °C at most. See our PTFE hoses for comparison.

Sizes and ratings

A size table follows with 93 part numbers from 1/4" (DN 6) to 12" (DN 300), unbraided and with one or two braids. Working pressure falls with size and rises with braid count; the highest working pressure in the size tables is 275 bar, and the maker's brochure quotes up to 300 bar. Read the value for your size and braid count from the table.

Ordering

The supplier states a test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 with each production run, with leak testing by air immersion and hydraulic test up to 1,500 bar. Special assemblies include double elbows, pump and vibration connectors, steam-jacketed hoses and reinforced ends. To quote, send the size, braid count, medium, temperature, pressure, end fittings, length and quantity. Supplied from Dubai, UAE; availability and lead time are confirmed at quotation.
